svg.aria-label: The architecture of skills-hub: four layers — the real folders on disk, the domain crate, the Tauri adapter and the React interface — with dependencies pointing inwards, crossed by three paths: a scan from folder to card, a toggle that moves the file and tells both webviews, and the seams (a banned tauri dependency, generated bindings) that keep the layers apart.
svg.title: skills-hub architecture
svg.desc: The architecture of skills-hub: four layers — the real folders on disk, the domain crate, the Tauri adapter and the React interface — with dependencies pointing inwards, crossed by three paths: a scan from folder to card, a toggle that moves the file and tells both webviews, and the seams (a banned tauri dependency, generated bindings) that keep the layers apart.
